description: This is a C# source file defining a static helper class 'SecurityTestHelper' for creating, rendering, and saving PDF documents with security features for testing purposes within the MigraDoc testing framework.

classes.name: SecurityTestHelper
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for creating and manipulating PDF documents with security options for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateEmptyTestDocument
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty MigraDoc Document.

methods.name: CreateStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Creates and returns a standard MigraDoc Document with a single paragraph containing text.

methods.name: RenderDocument
methods.description: Renders a MigraDoc Document into a PDF using PdfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: RenderSecuredDocument
methods.description: Renders a Document into a secured PDF, applying security options.

methods.name: WriteSecuredTestDocument
methods.description: Creates a secured PDF document and saves it to a file.

methods.name: RenderSecuredStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Creates and renders a standard document into a secured PDF.

methods.name: WriteStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Creates and saves a standard PDF document to a file.

methods.name: GetStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Generates a standard test PDF file and returns its filename.

methods.name: WriteSecuredStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Creates and saves a secured standard PDF to a file.

methods.name: GetSecuredStandardTestDocument
methods.description: Returns the filename of a secured standard test PDF, creating it if necessary based on security options.
